scope: Completed 3D monochromatic and original travelling-packet deep-water scenarios; one seed; no new simulations.

monochromatic.current: Banded jets at both resolutions; quantitatively different amplitudes.
monochromatic.PV: Broad upper-layer homogenization not demonstrated; small PV changes sensitive to resolution and spatial remainder.
monochromatic.spectral: Inverse horizontal transfer supported at low cutoffs; sharp barrier and constant radial-flux range unestablished.
monochromatic.momentum: Resolved eddy stress drives mean-current growth; 3D stress predominantly opposes mean-energy growth.
monochromatic.wave_carrier: Negative intrinsic phase propagation supported early and late; source, group-velocity and absorption link not established.

packet.current: Wave-induced surface countercurrent; strong transverse dependence remains.
packet.PV: Upper-layer mean-PV gradient grows; substantial 3D sources and spatial removal.
packet.spectral: No clean difference in angular exclusion from control; reduced self-transfer is not the full 3D budget.
packet.momentum: 3D stress supplies the paired countercurrent and reduces Lagrangian mean energy.
packet.wave_carrier: 2D vortex-wave radiation not established as driver.

limits: Monochromatic refinement is evidence of robust jet formation, not full quantitative convergence
Packet has one resolution and short local exposure
A reference operator separates physical transport from the spatial remainder; exact closure is not convergence
Current formation is not alone a spectral-barrier or PV-staircase test
